name: Weapon Juggle (Combat)
body:
You can freely move items between your hand and inventory.

Prerequisite: Dex 13, Quick Draw, Sleight Of Hand 3 ranks

Benefit: You can sheath a weapon, pick up an item from the ground, or trade weapons from one hand to another (even if both are holding something) as a free action and without provoking an attack of opportunity. You cannot use this feat to make an off-hand attack with the same weapon used to perform a main hand attack in the same round or vice versa.
